text:
Anna: dropped a compact mock of a p95 mini-strip + heatmap preview in Figma. trying a slim minimap with dense ticks and a translucent focus window. link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/minimap-compact (image attached)
Ben: neat. two quick UX calls: 1) dense ticks look noisy at <240px, 2) the focus window touch target is tiny on mobile. recommend 12-16px handle tap area. :iphone:
Priya: agree on tap area. for the ticks, can we fade low-intensity ticks and only bold the 95+ bucket? gives visual hierarchy without extra space.
Jess: accessibility note: focus state is required for keyboard + high-contrast. current mock uses a 1px outline that won't pass 4.5:1. suggest 3px solid focus ring or a thicker shadow. also add aria-labels for the minimap and the handle region.
Marco: implementation POV: rendering ticks into WebGL/canvas is cheaper than DOM. also we can compress tick data into ranges to reduce draw calls. happy to prototype.
Anna: copy tweak suggestion for the tooltip when dragging: current: "Window: 10m-40m (p95 320ms)" proposed: "Viewing 1020m window — p95: 320ms" shorter and reads cleaner with screen readers. thoughts?
Ben: much cleaner. also propose a small secondary control under the minimap: "Apply to dashboard" (momento toggle) so users can preview without changing global time. label could be "Apply to dashboard (pin)"?
Priya: prefer "Sync to dashboard" or "Pin selection"? language should match the top-level timepicker (we already use "Sync" there). consistency wins.
Jess: keyboard shortcuts suggestion: `[` and `]` to nudge left/right by 5s, `Shift+[ / ]` for 30s. plus `Enter` to pin/apply. add aria-live to announce "Range pinned" or "Range previewed" on toggle.
Marco: note on animation: when minimap animates the main chart, keep animation under 300ms to preserve sense of direct manipulation. if pinned, update URL params so session restores.
Anna: good call on URL state. next steps: I'll update mocks with faded minor ticks, bolder 95+ ticks, 14px tap area, stronger focus ring, and new copy "Viewing 1020m window 34 p95: 320ms". I'll swap toggle copy to "Sync to dashboard" per Priya and add a small hover hint. will share updated Figma by EOD.
Ben: tagging @Marco and @Jess to align on canvas approach + aria implementation once mocks are live. thanks all. :rocket:
